title: PPG-MS10 — PDF Knowledge Extraction (4 authoritative post-processor PDFs unextracted)
description: Closes the highest-leverage knowledge gap surfaced in the audit: 4 authoritative post-processor PDFs in resources are completely unextracted. Once extracted, they will populate the tribal-knowledge store with hundreds of concrete machine-specific behaviors that the generator currently has to guess at. Uses the existing /pdf-learn skill backed by DocumentKnowledgeExtractionEngine.
rationale: Pre-precompact audit found the tribal store has 280 PP tribal tips but the 4 unextracted PDFs (Fusion Post Processor Manual, hyperMILL Post Configuration Guide, Mastercam MP/MPMaster, Heidenhain CYCLE/CYCL DEF reference) typically yield 100-300 tips each. This is ~1000 free tips behind a /pdf-learn invocation — by far the cheapest knowledge gain on the board.
leverage_existing: DocumentKnowledgeExtractionEngine — extracts tribal tips, formulas, procedures from PDF

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Generator emits a Heidenhain CYCL DEF 220 polar pattern but uses wrong default Q-parameter order.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms10: Generator infers from Fanuc convention; Heidenhain treats Q-params positionally and the order is wrong. CYCL DEF compiles but cuts the wrong pattern. Operator catches it on prove-out, shop loses 30 min.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms10: Heidenhain CYCL DEF reference PDF extracted → tribal tip 'CYCL DEF 220: Q-param order is Q216,Q217,Q244,Q245,Q246' wired to HeidenhainDialectEmitterEngine → emit correct on first try.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Reference manuals stop being PDFs on a shelf and become living tribal tips.

units.title: PDF inventory + classification
units.scope: Walk H:/prism/resources/ tree exhaustively; classify EVERY PDF (not just 4) plus generic CPS/PST/MP/MCAM/ESP files; mark the PP-relevant ones; record where each slots in.

units.title: /pdf-learn batch extract on 4 PP PDFs
units.scope: /pdf-learn batch extract on identified PP PDFs (Fusion Post Processor Manual, hyperMILL Post Configuration Guide, Mastercam MP/MPMaster, Heidenhain CYCL DEF reference, Esprit reference if found, plus any others surfaced in U-PPGM62); persist outputs into the 3 PP tribal stores.

units.title: Tribal tip insertion + dedup against existing 280 tips
units.scope: Use DuplicationGuardEngine to dedup; extract net-new tips; categorize by (vendor, controller, topic)

units.title: Cross-link tribal tips to engine code
units.scope: For each new tip with concrete behavior (e.g., 'CYCL DEF 220 Q-param order'), add a code reference comment in the relevant dialect emitter so future readers see provenance

completion_criteria: All 4 PP PDFs classified, extracted, persisted into tribal stores
Net new tribal tip count ≥600 (audit baseline 280 + ≥600 = ≥880)
Every dialect emitter (PPG-MS5) has at least 30 tribal-tip-backed behaviors with PDF citations
Duplication guard run successful; no tip count regression
